title: 构造 3.3

source.quote: Construction 3.3. Note that π_{0} ∶Sptr_{≥0} →Ab can be identiﬁed with the functor

conclusion: $\pi_{0}\colon\Sptr_{\ge0}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ 经 $\mathrm{Ab}\simeq\Sptr^{\heartsuit}$ 识别为 $\tau_{\le0}$，有右伴随 $R\mapsto HR$；左伴随对称幺半使右伴随右松弛，得 $\Alg_{E_{k}}(\mathrm{Ab})\to\Alg_{E_{k}}(\Sptr)$：结合环给 $E_{1}$-环 $HR$，交换环给 $E_{\infty}$-环 $HR$
